title: Site Reliability Engineer Roadmap
summary: Build from cloud fundamentals into Linux, networking, automation, observability, Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-code and production reliability.

facts.Timeline assumption: This roadmap assumes a four-year B.Tech/B.E. beginning in 2026 and graduation around 2030. If your institution follows a three-year lateral-entry route or another academic calendar, shift the semester milestones rather than dropping them.

horizons.question: What can I enter now?
horizons.output: use the course/cluster roadmap to build an entry-level cloud, DevOps, infrastructure or SRE portfolio.

horizons.question: How should I specialise?
horizons.output: deepen one cloud platform, Kubernetes, IaC, observability and production operations.

horizons.question: How should I evolve?
horizons.output: progress toward senior/staff reliability, platform engineering, architecture or technical leadership.

horizons.question: How can I remain relevant?
horizons.output: maintain expertise in distributed systems, automation, security, cost, reliability and emerging infrastructure technologies.

rows.text: Linux, Git, Python/Bash basics, networking fundamentals
NPTEL Cloud Computing · GitHub Actions docs
Git repo with Linux commands, shell scripts and networking notes; 20+ meaningful commits
Build a small web service and deploy it to a cloud environment
AWS Cloud Practitioner · Microsoft Azure Fundamentals
Public service with README, architecture diagram and deployment instructions
Docker, HTTP, DNS, TLS, load balancing and basic cloud networking
Containerise an application and reproduce deployment from a clean machine
Pipeline automatically builds, tests and deploys on a pull request; successful run recorded
Terraform/IaC, cloud IAM, monitoring and logging
Terraform creates and destroys a reproducible environment; infrastructure is version-controlled
Kubernetes deployment with health checks, logs, alerts and a written incident postmortem
Production-style SRE project: SLOs, SLIs, alerts, rollback and capacity
Document 3 SLIs, 2–3 SLOs, alert rules, failure test and recovery procedure
One polished reliability project + GitHub profile + 2 incident postmortems + internship/placement applications

blocks.text: Microsoft's current AZ-900 material explicitly includes cloud concepts, compute, networking, storage, IaC and monitoring, making it a useful foundation rather than an SRE substitute. Microsoft Learn
Four-year honours variant

If your institution offers the 4-year honours variant, use the additional time for a deeper distributed-systems/reliability project, research assistantship, open-source contributions or an extended industry internship rather than simply collecting more introductory certificates.

blocks.label: Evolve and stay relevant, 2035–2046
blocks.text: Move beyond operating individual servers toward distributed-system design, reliability economics, observability, security, platform engineering, capacity planning and automation. Google's SRE material describes SRE as a job function, mindset and set of engineering practices for running reliable production systems. Google Cloud

blocks.text: PhD routes

items.text: PhD in Computer Science — distributed systems

blocks.text: Keep the technical centre of gravity on distributed systems, reliability engineering, observability, infrastructure automation, security, cloud economics and platform design. At senior levels, the work increasingly involves reliability strategy, architecture, technical standards, incident leadership and mentoring rather than only writing deployment scripts.
